text: The deleted initWithParams wrapper is not the current startup entry point. The window load listener calls gPermissionManager.onLoad, which reads window.arguments[0] and invokes init. init uses permissionType and manageCapability, updates the visible controls, sends the permission-flush notification, observes perm-changed, then focuses the URL field after loading permissions. The unload listener calls uninit. This is the inspected startup path; repeated reuse of one live dialog was not exercised. This is static source and test-code inspection at the fixed accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending.
title: Load the permissions dialog through its manager and window arguments
